overview: This 272-page file tracks Japanese merchant vessels across the Pacific, the Americas, and Southeast Asia in 1941. Consular telegrams and Navy copies record routes, cargoes, fuel, and passengers, alongside reports on shipping recalls, canal delays, suspended service, and suspected fishing-vessel activity.
interest: Detailed port reports reveal changing Japanese routes and shipping practices in the months before the Pacific War.
